---- MODULE etcd_raft ----
EXTENDS etcd_raftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
\* Election certificates are represented without adding history variables.
\* A ballot is a triple <<voter, term, candidate>>.  ARAllVotes collects
\* pending replies, replies on the network, and votes counted by active
\* candidates or leaders.  Each voter has at most one candidate per term.
\* Network and counted ballots are additionally bounded by durable state;
\* pending ballots are bounded by current state.  These two bounds make
\* persistence and restart preserve the same uniqueness invariant.
\* Leaders retain a majority certificate, so quorum intersection finishes
\* the election-uniqueness proof.

LOCAL ARBags == INSTANCE BagsTheorems
LOCAL ARProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL ARFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

ARConfig == [jointConfig |-> <<InitServer, {}>>, learners |-> {}]
ARFunction(f) == f = [i \in Server |-> f[i]]
ARActive(i) == state[i] \in {Candidate, Leader}
ARMessage(m) ==
    /\ m.msource \in Server
    /\ m.mdest \in Server
    /\ m.mterm \in Nat
    /\ m.mtype \in {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse,
                    AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse}
    /\ m.mtype \in {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse} =>
          /\ m.msource \in InitServer
          /\ m.mdest \in InitServer
    /\ m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse => m.mvoteGranted \in BOOLEAN

ARPacketVotes(S) ==
    {<<m.msource, m.mterm, m.mdest>> :
      m \in {n \in S : n.mtype = RequestVoteResponse /\ n.mvoteGranted}}
ARCountedVotes ==
    {b \in InitServer \X Nat \X Server :
        /\ ARActive(b[3])
        /\ b[2] = currentTerm[b[3]]
        /\ b[1] \in votesGranted[b[3]]}
ARPermanentVotes == ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN messages) \cup ARCountedVotes
ARAllVotes == ARPermanentVotes \cup ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN pendingMessages)
ARDurableTerms == [i \in Server |-> durableState[i].currentTerm]
ARDurableVotes == [i \in Server |-> durableState[i].votedFor]
ARBound(B, ts, vs) ==
    \A b \in B :
      /\ b[1] \in Server /\ b[2] \in Nat /\ b[3] \in Server
      /\ b[2] <= ts[b[1]]
      /\ b[2] = ts[b[1]] => vs[b[1]] = b[3]
ARUnique(B) ==
    \A b, c \in B : b[1] = c[1] /\ b[2] = c[2] => b[3] = c[3]
ARBase ==
    /\ currentTerm \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ state \in [Server -> {Follower, Candidate, Leader}]
    /\ votedFor \in [Server -> Server \cup {Nil}]
    /\ votesGranted \in [Server -> SUBSET InitServer]
    /\ ARFunction(config)
    /\ ARFunction(durableState)
    /\ \A i \in Server :
          /\ config[i] = ARConfig
          /\ durableState[i].config = ARConfig
          /\ durableState[i].currentTerm \in Nat
          /\ durableState[i].votedFor \in Server \cup {Nil}
          /\ durableState[i].currentTerm <= currentTerm[i]
          /\ ARActive(i) => votedFor[i] = i /\ i \in InitServer
ARCertificates ==
    \A i \in Server : state[i] = Leader =>
       \E Q \in Quorum(InitServer) : Q \subseteq votesGranted[i]
ARInv ==
    /\ ARBase
    /\ IsABag(messages) /\ IsABag(pendingMessages)
    /\ \A m \in DOMAIN messages \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages : ARMessage(m)
    /\ ARCertificates
    /\ ARBound(ARAllVotes, currentTerm, votedFor)
    /\ ARBound(ARPermanentVotes, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes)
    /\ ARUnique(ARAllVotes)

LEMMA ARAddBag ==
    ASSUME NEW B, IsABag(B), NEW m
    PROVE /\ IsABag(WithMessage(m,B))
          /\ DOMAIN WithMessage(m,B) = DOMAIN B \cup {m}
BY ARProof!SMTT("r10") DEF IsABag, WithMessage, SetToBag, (+)

LEMMA ARBagDefinitions ==
    /\ \A x : IsABag(x) = ARBags!IsABag(x)
    /\ \A x,y : x (-) y = ARBags!(-)(x,y)
    /\ \A x,y : x (+) y = ARBags!(+)(x,y)
    /\ \A x : SetToBag(x) = ARBags!SetToBag(x)
BY ARProof!Isa DEF IsABag, ARBags!IsABag, (-), ARBags!(-),
    (+), ARBags!(+), SetToBag, ARBags!SetToBag

LEMMA ARRemoveBag ==
    ASSUME NEW B, IsABag(B), NEW m
    PROVE /\ IsABag(WithoutMessage(m,B))
          /\ DOMAIN WithoutMessage(m,B) \subseteq DOMAIN B
BY ARBagDefinitions, ARBags!Bags_Difference, ARBags!Bags_SetToBagIsABag,
   ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF WithoutMessage

LEMMA ARPendingBags ==
    ASSUME IsABag(messages), IsABag(pendingMessages), NEW i
    PROVE /\ IsABag(ClearPendingMessages(i))
          /\ DOMAIN ClearPendingMessages(i) =
               {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i}
          /\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i) (+) messages)
          /\ DOMAIN (PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) =
               DOMAIN messages \cup {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i}
<1>1. IsABag(PendingMessages(i))
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF IsABag, PendingMessages
<1>2. /\ IsABag(ClearPendingMessages(i))
      /\ DOMAIN ClearPendingMessages(i) =
           {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i}
  BY <1>1, ARBagDefinitions, ARBags!Bags_Difference, ARProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF ClearPendingMessages, PendingMessages, IsABag
<1>3. /\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i) (+) messages)
      /\ DOMAIN (PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) =
           DOMAIN messages \cup {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i}
  BY <1>1, ARBagDefinitions, ARBags!Bags_Union, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF PendingMessages
<1> QED BY ARProof!SMTT("r3"), <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA ARVoteSubset ==
    ASSUME NEW S, NEW T, S \subseteq T
    PROVE ARPacketVotes(S) \subseteq ARPacketVotes(T)
BY ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARPacketVotes

LEMMA ARVoteUnion ==
    ASSUME NEW S, NEW T
    PROVE ARPacketVotes(S \cup T) = ARPacketVotes(S) \cup ARPacketVotes(T)
BY ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARPacketVotes

LEMMA ARInit == Init => ARInv
BY DistinctRoles, ARProof!SMTT("r20")
   DEF Init, InitMessageVars, InitServerVars, InitCandidateVars,
       InitLeaderVars, InitLogVars, InitConfigVars, InitDurableState,
       ARInv, ARBase, ARConfig, ARFunction, ARActive, ARCertificates,
       ARBound, ARUnique, ARAllVotes, ARPermanentVotes, ARCountedVotes,
       ARPacketVotes, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes, IsABag, EmptyBag,
       SetToBag

LEMMA ARCountedUnchanged ==
    UNCHANGED <<state, currentTerm, votesGranted>> => UNCHANGED ARCountedVotes
BY ARProof!Isa DEF ARCountedVotes, ARActive

LEMMA ARBaseUnchanged ==
    UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, state, votedFor, votesGranted, config, durableState>>
      => (ARBase' = ARBase)
BY ARProof!Isa DEF ARBase, ARFunction, ARActive

LEMMA ARCertificatesUnchanged ==
    UNCHANGED <<state, votesGranted>> => UNCHANGED ARCertificates
BY ARProof!Isa DEF ARCertificates

LEMMA ARDurableUnchanged ==
    UNCHANGED durableState => UNCHANGED <<ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes>>
BY ARProof!Isa DEF ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes

LEMMA ARUnchanged ==
    ASSUME ARInv,
           UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, state, votedFor, votesGranted, config, durableState>>,
           IsABag(messages'), IsABag(pendingMessages'),
           \A m \in DOMAIN messages' \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages' : ARMessage(m),
           ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN messages') \subseteq ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN messages),
           ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN pendingMessages') \subseteq ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN pendingMessages)
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. UNCHANGED <<ARBase, ARCertificates, ARCountedVotes, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes>>
  BY ARBaseUnchanged, ARCertificatesUnchanged, ARCountedUnchanged,
     ARDurableUnchanged, ARProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>2. /\ ARPermanentVotes' \subseteq ARPermanentVotes
      /\ ARAllVotes' \subseteq ARAllVotes
  BY <1>1, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARPermanentVotes, ARAllVotes
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARUnique

LEMMA ARNoElectionChange ==
    ASSUME ARInv,
           UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, state, votedFor, votesGranted, config,
                       durableState, messages, pendingMessages>>
    PROVE ARInv'
BY ARUnchanged, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv

LEMMA ARSendOrdinary ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW m, ARMessage(m), m.mtype # RequestVoteResponse,
           Send(m),
           UNCHANGED <<messages, currentTerm, state, votedFor, votesGranted,
                       config, durableState>>
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. /\ IsABag(pendingMessages')
      /\ DOMAIN pendingMessages' = DOMAIN pendingMessages \cup {m}
  BY ARAddBag, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, Send, SendDirect
<1>2. ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN pendingMessages') \subseteq ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN pendingMessages)
  BY <1>1, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARPacketVotes
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, ARUnchanged, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv

LEMMA ARDiscard ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW m, Discard(m),
           UNCHANGED <<pendingMessages, currentTerm, state, votedFor,
                       votesGranted, config, durableState>>
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. /\ IsABag(messages')
      /\ DOMAIN messages' \subseteq DOMAIN messages
  BY ARRemoveBag, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, Discard, DiscardDirect
<1>2. ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN messages') \subseteq ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN messages)
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r3"), <1>1, ARVoteSubset
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, ARUnchanged, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv

LEMMA ARReplyOrdinary ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW m, NEW n, ARMessage(m), m.mtype # RequestVoteResponse,
           Reply(m,n),
           UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, state, votedFor, votesGranted,
                       config, durableState>>
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. /\ IsABag(pendingMessages')
      /\ DOMAIN pendingMessages' = DOMAIN pendingMessages \cup {m}
      /\ IsABag(messages')
      /\ DOMAIN messages' \subseteq DOMAIN messages
  BY ARAddBag, ARRemoveBag, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, Reply, ReplyDirect
<1>2. /\ ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN messages') \subseteq ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN messages)
      /\ ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN pendingMessages') \subseteq ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN pendingMessages)
  BY <1>1, ARVoteSubset, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARPacketVotes
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, ARUnchanged, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv

LEMMA ARSendVote ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in InitServer, NEW j \in InitServer,
           NEW m, ARMessage(m),
           m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse,
           m.msource = i, m.mdest = j, m.mterm = currentTerm[i],
           m.mvoteGranted \in BOOLEAN,
           m.mvoteGranted => votedFor[i] \in {Nil,j},
           votedFor' = IF m.mvoteGranted THEN [votedFor EXCEPT ![i] = j] ELSE votedFor,
           UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, state, votesGranted, config, durableState>>,
           pendingMessages' = WithMessage(m,pendingMessages),
           IsABag(messages'), DOMAIN messages' \subseteq DOMAIN messages
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. /\ IsABag(pendingMessages')
      /\ DOMAIN pendingMessages' = DOMAIN pendingMessages \cup {m}
      /\ i \in Server /\ j \in Server
  BY ARAddBag, InitServerSubset, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv
<1>2. ARBase'
  BY NilNotServer, <1>1, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARFunction, ARActive
<1>3. /\ ARCertificates'
      /\ \A n \in DOMAIN messages' \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages' : ARMessage(n)
  BY <1>1, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARCertificates
<1>4. /\ ARPermanentVotes' \subseteq ARPermanentVotes
      /\ ARAllVotes' \subseteq
            ARAllVotes \cup (IF m.mvoteGranted THEN {<<i,currentTerm[i],j>>} ELSE {})
  <2>1. UNCHANGED ARCountedVotes
    BY ARCountedUnchanged, ARProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2> QED BY <1>1, <2>1, ARProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF ARAllVotes, ARPermanentVotes, ARPacketVotes
<1>5. ARBound(ARPermanentVotes', ARDurableTerms', ARDurableVotes')
  BY <1>4, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes
<1>6. ARBound(ARAllVotes', currentTerm', votedFor')
  BY <1>1, <1>4, NilNotServer, ARProof!SMTT("r10") DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARBound
<1>7. ARUnique(ARAllVotes')
  BY <1>1, <1>4, NilNotServer, ARProof!SMTT("r10") DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARUnique
<1> QED BY ARProof!SMTT("r3"), <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7 DEF ARInv


LEMMA ARChangeTerm ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW t \in Nat,
           t > currentTerm[i],
           currentTerm' = [currentTerm EXCEPT ![i] = t],
           \/ /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![i] = Follower]
              /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![i] = Nil]
              /\ UNCHANGED votesGranted
           \/ /\ i \in InitServer
              /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![i] = Candidate]
              /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![i] = i]
              /\ votesGranted' = [votesGranted EXCEPT ![i] = {}],
           UNCHANGED <<config, durableState, messages, pendingMessages>>
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. ARBase' /\ ARCertificates'
  BY DistinctRoles, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCertificates, ARActive, ARFunction
<1>2. /\ ARCountedVotes' \subseteq ARCountedVotes
      /\ ARPermanentVotes' \subseteq ARPermanentVotes
      /\ ARAllVotes' \subseteq ARAllVotes
  BY DistinctRoles, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCountedVotes, ARActive, ARPermanentVotes, ARAllVotes, ARPacketVotes
<1>3. ARBound(ARAllVotes', currentTerm', votedFor')
  BY <1>2, ARProof!SMTT("r10") DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARBase
<1>4. ARBound(ARPermanentVotes', ARDurableTerms', ARDurableVotes')
  BY <1>2, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes
<1>5. ARUnique(ARAllVotes')
  BY <1>2, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARUnique
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARMessage, IsABag

LEMMA ARDropRole ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server,
           state' = [state EXCEPT ![i] = Follower],
           UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, votedFor, votesGranted, config,
                       durableState, messages, pendingMessages>>
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. ARBase' /\ ARCertificates'
  BY DistinctRoles, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCertificates, ARActive, ARFunction
<1>2. /\ ARPermanentVotes' \subseteq ARPermanentVotes
      /\ ARAllVotes' \subseteq ARAllVotes
  BY DistinctRoles, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCountedVotes, ARActive, ARPermanentVotes, ARAllVotes, ARPacketVotes
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARUnique, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes, ARMessage, IsABag

LEMMA ARLead ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server, BecomeLeader(i)
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. GetConfig(i) = InitServer
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARConfig, GetConfig, GetJointConfig
<1>2. ARBase' /\ ARCertificates'
  BY <1>1, DistinctRoles, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCertificates, ARActive, ARFunction, BecomeLeader,
         messageVars, candidateVars, logVars, configVars
<1>3. /\ ARPermanentVotes' = ARPermanentVotes
      /\ ARAllVotes' = ARAllVotes
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCountedVotes, ARActive, ARPermanentVotes, ARAllVotes, ARPacketVotes,
         BecomeLeader, messageVars, candidateVars, logVars, configVars
<1> QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARUnique, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes, ARMessage,
         IsABag, BecomeLeader, messageVars, candidateVars, logVars, configVars

LEMMA ARCountVote ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages,
           m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse,
           HandleRequestVoteResponse(m.mdest, m.msource, m)
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. ARMessage(m) /\ m.msource \in Server /\ m.mdest \in Server
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARMessage
<1>2. /\ IsABag(messages') /\ DOMAIN messages' \subseteq DOMAIN messages
      /\ UNCHANGED <<pendingMessages, currentTerm, state, votedFor, config, durableState>>
  BY ARRemoveBag, ARProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF ARInv, HandleRequestVoteResponse, Discard, DiscardDirect, serverVars,
         leaderVars, logVars, configVars
<1>3. ARBase' /\ ARCertificates'
  BY <1>1, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARMessage, ARBase, ARCertificates, ARActive, ARFunction,
         HandleRequestVoteResponse, serverVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
<1>4. /\ ARPermanentVotes' \subseteq ARPermanentVotes
      /\ ARAllVotes' \subseteq ARAllVotes
  BY <1>1, <1>2, ARProof!SMTT("r15")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCountedVotes, ARActive, ARPermanentVotes,
         ARAllVotes, ARPacketVotes, HandleRequestVoteResponse, serverVars,
         leaderVars, logVars, configVars
<1> QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARUnique, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes, ARMessage, IsABag

LEMMA ARCrash ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server, Restart(i)
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. /\ IsABag(pendingMessages')
      /\ DOMAIN pendingMessages' = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i}
  BY ARPendingBags, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, Restart
<1>2. ARBase' /\ ARCertificates'
  BY DistinctRoles, ARProof!SMTT("r15")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCertificates, ARActive, ARFunction, Restart
<1>3. /\ ARPermanentVotes' \subseteq ARPermanentVotes
      /\ ARAllVotes' \subseteq ARAllVotes
      /\ \A b \in ARPacketVotes(DOMAIN pendingMessages') : b[1] # i
  BY <1>1, DistinctRoles, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCountedVotes, ARActive, ARPermanentVotes, ARAllVotes, ARPacketVotes, Restart
<1>4. ARBound(ARAllVotes', currentTerm', votedFor')
  BY <1>1, <1>3, ARProof!SMTT("r15")
     DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARBase, ARAllVotes, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes, Restart
<1>5. ARBound(ARPermanentVotes', ARDurableTerms', ARDurableVotes')
  BY <1>3, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes, Restart
<1>6. ARUnique(ARAllVotes')
  BY <1>3, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARUnique
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, ARProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF ARInv, ARMessage, IsABag, Restart

LEMMA ARPersist ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server, Ready(i)
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. /\ IsABag(pendingMessages') /\ IsABag(messages')
      /\ DOMAIN pendingMessages' = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i}
      /\ DOMAIN messages' = DOMAIN messages \cup
                                  {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i}
  BY ARPendingBags, ARProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF ARInv, Ready, SendPendingMessages, ClearPendingMessages
<1>2. ARBase' /\ ARCertificates'
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCertificates, ARActive, ARFunction, Ready,
         PersistState, serverVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, logVars, configVars
<1>3. /\ ARAllVotes' \subseteq ARAllVotes
      /\ ARPermanentVotes' \subseteq ARAllVotes
      /\ \A b \in ARPermanentVotes' : b[1] # i => b \in ARPermanentVotes
  BY <1>1, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARCountedVotes, ARActive, ARPermanentVotes, ARAllVotes, ARPacketVotes,
         Ready, serverVars, leaderVars, candidateVars, logVars, configVars
<1>4. ARBound(ARAllVotes', currentTerm', votedFor') /\ ARUnique(ARAllVotes')
  BY <1>3, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARUnique, Ready, serverVars, candidateVars,
         leaderVars, logVars, configVars
<1>5. ARBound(ARPermanentVotes', ARDurableTerms', ARDurableVotes')
  BY <1>3, ARProof!SMTT("r15")
     DEF ARInv, ARBound, ARBase, ARFunction, ARDurableTerms, ARDurableVotes, Ready, PersistState,
         serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARMessage

LEMMA ARSolicit ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, RequestVote(i,j)
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. /\ i \in InitServer /\ j \in InitServer /\ votedFor[i] = i
      /\ UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, state, votesGranted, config, durableState, messages>>
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF ARInv, ARBase, ARActive, ARConfig, GetConfig, GetJointConfig,
         GetLearners, RequestVote, serverVars, candidateVars, logVars, configVars
<1>2. CASE i # j
  BY <1>2, <1>1, ARSendOrdinary, DistinctMessageTypes, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF RequestVote, ARInv, ARBase, ARMessage, serverVars, candidateVars,
         leaderVars, logVars, configVars
<1>3. CASE i = j
  BY <1>3, <1>1, ARSendVote, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF RequestVote, Send, SendDirect, ARInv, ARBase, ARMessage,
         serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
<1> QED BY ARProof!SMTT("r3"), <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA ARAnswerVote ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages,
           m.mtype = RequestVoteRequest,
           HandleRequestVoteRequest(m.mdest,m.msource,m)
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. ARMessage(m)
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv
<1>2. /\ IsABag(messages') /\ DOMAIN messages' \subseteq DOMAIN messages
  BY ARRemoveBag, ARProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF ARInv, HandleRequestVoteRequest, Reply, ReplyDirect
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, ARSendVote, DistinctMessageTypes, ARProof!SMTT("r15")
     DEF HandleRequestVoteRequest, Reply, ReplyDirect, ARInv, ARBase, ARMessage,
         serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars

LEMMA ARAppendSend ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, NEW subtype, NEW range,
           AppendEntriesInRangeToPeer(subtype,i,j,range)
    PROVE ARInv'
BY ARSendOrdinary, DistinctMessageTypes, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
   DEF AppendEntriesInRangeToPeer, ARInv, ARBase, ARMessage,
       serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars

LEMMA ARAppendSelf ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server, AppendEntriesToSelf(i)
    PROVE ARInv'
BY ARSendOrdinary, DistinctMessageTypes, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
   DEF AppendEntriesToSelf, ARInv, ARBase, ARMessage,
       serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars

LEMMA ARAnswerAppend ==
    ASSUME ARInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, m.mtype = AppendEntriesRequest,
           HandleAppendEntriesRequest(m.mdest,m.msource,m)
    PROVE ARInv'
<1>1. ARMessage(m) /\ m.msource \in Server /\ m.mdest \in Server
  BY ARProof!SMTT("r5") DEF ARInv, ARMessage
<1>2. CASE \E ok : RejectAppendEntriesRequest(m.mdest,m.msource,m,ok)
  BY <1>2, <1>1, ARReplyOrdinary, DistinctMessageTypes, ARProof!SMTT("r10")
     DEF RejectAppendEntriesRequest, HandleAppendEntriesRequest,
         ARInv, ARBase, ARMessage, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars,

  <2>1. CASE \E i \in Server : Timeout(i)

  <2>2. CASE \E i \in Server : StepDownToFollower(i)
    <3>1. currentTerm \in [Server -> Nat]

    <3> QED BY <1>1, <2>2, <3>1, ARDropRole, ARProof!SMTT("r5")

           candidateVars, leaderVars, configVars
  <2> QED
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, ARSolicit, ARLead, ARAppendSend, ARAppendSelf,

  <2>1. CASE \E m \in DOMAIN messages : DropMessage(m)

  <2> QED BY ARProof!SMTT("r3"), <1>2, <2>1, <2>2 DEF NextUnreliable

  BY ARProof!SMTT("r3"), <1>3, ARCrash DEF NextCrash

  BY ARProof!SMTT("r3"), <1>4, ARNoElectionChange DEF vars, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars,

<1>1. ASSUME ARInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
